24.name: Shadumbra's Head
desc: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
objectives: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
details: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it. The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt. Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
completion: A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt! Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.

BShadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here. Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger. Thanks to you, this danger has abated.

48.name: Sweet Amber
desc: Bring Holy Spring Water to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.
objectives: Bring Holy Spring Water to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.
details: In the land to the south where vines twist and creep$BLies a hidden well where the water runs deep$BPure as the Light's sacred Daughter$BBring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
completion: Hiccup! Ho Ho!

72.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
objectives: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
details: My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was. He had to mop the blood up after the massacre. But that's neither here nor there.

BThe last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up. Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction. Blame the tax vultures. I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk. Who knows what you might find.
completion: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .

96.name: Call of Water
desc: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
details: Take shard. Take shard and give life.
BGive life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.
BYou protect and give life with water's power.
completion: This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, $N.
BI am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.
BUse it well, and good luck.

BYour next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a shaman trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.

120.name: Messenger to Stormwind
desc: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind. The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
objectives: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind. The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
details: These are trying times, $c. The township is under constant siege. Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat. The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance. Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately. Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad.
BNow make haste!
completion: At ease, $C.

BMagistrate Solomon is a noble leader. His words carry great weight with me. I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him. Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support. Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.

144.name: Messenger to Westfall
desc: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.
objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.
details: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read. But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia. If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.
BTake this response to your master in Redridge, $c. And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
completion: I do say, this is not good at all. I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire. What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people? Bah, I should not ponder aloud.
BHere, messenger. Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township. I might call upon you again.

168.name: Collecting Memories
desc: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
objectives: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
details: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in. If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them. If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
completion: Thank you for collecting these, $N. Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy. I will see to it that the families are notified.

192.name: Panther Mastery
desc: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers.
objectives: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers.
details: Now the hard part. A true panther hunter can show skill by dropping Shadowmaw Panthers, the deadliest in Stranglethorn. Prove to us that you can slay 10 of these beasts.
BIf you think they are hard to track, wait until you attempt to slay one....
completion: You've done well, $N!

216.name: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur
desc: Take down 8 Thistlefur Avengers and 8 Thistlefur Shaman; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
objectives: Take down 8 Thistlefur Avengers and 8 Thistlefur Shaman; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
details: The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion! Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post. It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.
B$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!
BProceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs. You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
completion: Well done $C, well done! I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements. The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!
BYou've earned your pay this day, hero. I salute you!

240.name: Return to Jitters
desc: Return to Jitters with the Dusky Crab Cakes.
objectives: Return to Jitters with the Dusky Crab Cakes.
details: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
completion: Aha! Thank you, $N. Those really hit the spot!
BAnd here, please let me pay you for these!

264.name: Until Death Do Us Part
desc: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.
objectives: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.
details: Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."
BWell, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!
BWell, witness what "justice" brings you, $N! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!
BTake this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
completion: You place the worthless pendant on the grave, and the gemstone within the setting seems to dull noticeably.

BAs you stand to leave, you look down at the pendant; it lies lifelessly over the hands of the relief sculpted into the top of the coffin. Your thoughts are interrupted by a stiff, cool breeze passing over the Sepulcher. For a moment everything around you is silent.

288.name: The Third Fleet
desc: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.
objectives: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.
details: I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!
BWe didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...
B...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
completion: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!

312.name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
desc: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.
objectives: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.
details: I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season. Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it! But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker. He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though. But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.
BYou seem a bit more stealthy than me. Perhaps you can retrieve my stash? I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.
completion: What a kind soul you are, $N! Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.

336.name: A Noble Brew
desc: Take the Black Claw Stout to Lord Wishock in the Hall of Petitioners.
objectives: Take the Black Claw Stout to Lord Wishock in the Hall of Petitioners.
details: Lord Wishock, like all men, has his weaknesses. His happens to be a fondness for liquor. The hypocrisy is astounding. The trite fool spends his days trying to shut down our little "tavern" while his nights are spent upstairs, running up a bill he never pays. Well, let's see how Wishock likes this special brew I have prepared for him: Black Claw stout. It's got quite a kick, $n.
BTake it to him and see how he likes it. Most likely the old fool is milling about the Hall of Petitioners.
completion: Ah, thank you for bringing me this fine looking stout, servant. Here's a copper for you. Now, out of sight with you and let me enjoy my drink!

360.name: Return to the Magistrate
desc: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
objectives: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
details: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
BAnd if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
completion: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.
BBut we will not give in. He will not take us again!

384.name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
desc: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.
objectives: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.
details: Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs! Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front.

BMaybe you can help me out? If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample! The secret's in the Malt!
completion: The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead$BAnd before all is done and anything said$BWe will have to fight for first dibs$BOn these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!

408.name: The Family Crypt
desc: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
objectives: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
BKill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
details: The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge. Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered. With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.
BThis cannot pass, and you must stop it. Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.
BAnd, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
completion: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.
BContinue the struggle as we all do, $N, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!

432.name: Those Blasted Troggs!
desc: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
objectives: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
details: Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!
BOhhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!
BThis can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!
BI'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
completion: Well, that makes me feel a little better...
BBut I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!

456.name: The Balance of Nature
desc: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
objectives: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
details: Greetings, $N. I am Conservator Ilthalaine. My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.
BThe spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

BUnfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large. Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts. Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
completion: You performed your duties well, $N.

480.name: The Weaver
desc: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
details: An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.
BYou must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
completion: The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. Your efforts have been fruitful, $N, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of Dalaran.
BWe must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... Plans must be made for the future.

504.name: Crushridge Warmongers
desc: Slay 10 Crushridge Warmongers, then return to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
objectives: Slay 10 Crushridge Warmongers, then return to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
details: Now that you've had a taste of the Crushridge ogres, I want you to really bloody their noses...

BGo into the Ruins of Alterac and seek out the Crushridge Warmongers. I want you to cut down a good number of them - that's the only way those brutes will learn to keep their distance from Alliance territory.
completion: Very good. Here is your reward.
BAnd when you were hunting those Warmongers, how did Alterac city look? It's in bad shape I would guess. Ogres are not known for their cleanliness.
BThankfully, your efforts will help keep them away from Southshore.

528.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
desc: Kill 15 Hillsbrad Peasants and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill 15 Hillsbrad Peasants and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
details: Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked. Most excellent.
BOur Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad. The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.
BProve them wrong, $N. Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants. Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.
BDismissed!
completion: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad. The battle goes well.

552.name: Helcular's Revenge
desc: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.
details: Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him. To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.
BSuch disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable. As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.
BWe will need Helcular's Rod first. Yeti overtook his ritual lair. Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
completion: You found it! Most excellent, $N!

576.name: Keep An Eye Out
desc: Dizzy One-Eye in Booty Bay wants you to retrieve his eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
objectives: Dizzy One-Eye in Booty Bay wants you to retrieve his eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
details: Avast! Who goes there?

BArgh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye. Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place! But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again.
BLast night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out. Took me eye, they did! Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay.
BHelp an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?
completion: Shiver me timbers and timber me shivers! Ye found me beautiful eye! Let's see if she still fits.
BShavas ho! Blimey, I can see!!

600.name: Venture Company Mining
desc: Bring 10 Singing Blue Crystals to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring 10 Singing Blue Crystals to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
details: The Venture Company has a string of operations through Stranglethorn which keeps hard-working goblins, like me, from making honest gold! Please, you must help me!

BThe Venture Company is mining near the Crystalvein Mine to the north. They can't get into the mine because of all the basilisks, but they're still able to dig up Singing Crystals from the surrounding hills.
BTake their crystals from them, and show them they don't have the run of the jungle.
BAnd... um... bring me those crystals as proof!
completion: Great! Wonderful! I can get a bundle for these!!
BThat Venture Company sure picked the wrong jungle to mine in, didn't they? We'd all be in better shape if they moved out of here.
BThank you, $N. You've done a good deed this day.

624.name: Cortello's Riddle
desc: Solve the riddle!
objectives: Solve the riddle!
details: There is an ornate, well-traveled bridge$BEast of Deadwind and south of Redridge$BUnderneath there waits something for you$BSome call it a hint, others a clue$BThere it will lie for endless tomorrows$BBiding its time in the Swamp of Sorrows
completion: The soggy parchment contains the next clue....

648.name: Rescue OOX-17/TN!
desc: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
details: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:

B"I need to move OOX-17/TN to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. I need you to escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, Steamwheedle Port! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things on line!"
B"Escort it safely to the port, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay! Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
completion: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-17/TN! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more developing, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in rebinding costs!
BPlease, take your choice of any of these items I have. Hopefully, you will make good use of one of them. Thank you again for your generous assistance, my robots and I are in your debt!

672.name: Raising Spirits
desc: Acquire 10 Highland Raptor Eyes from Highland Striders and Highland Thrashers for Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
objectives: Acquire 10 Highland Raptor Eyes from Highland Striders and Highland Thrashers for Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
details: We tried to settle him in, cheer him up, telling him stories of our mighty city at Orgrimmar in Kalimdor, but nothing would move him.

BTales of our young Warchief, Thrall, who bears the armor and hammer of Orgrim... but, perhaps... Perhaps! A demonstration of our newly found shamanistic magic would give him new hope. It is worth a try!
BA small object we could make for him, yes... Bring me some raptor eyes, and I will see what I can do.
completion: Excellent. The spirits of the raptors that gave these eyes will lend strength to the bearer of this amulet.

696.name: Attack on the Tower
desc: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
details: Here's what your lookin' for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, an' Trelane's ember agate.
BAll three should be in chests within the tower an' you shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres.

BThe tower's defenses won't take care of 'em on their own; you'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from 'em, an' they'll be sure to put the hurt on you.
BBe careful, an' good luck.
completion: Malin couldn't've asked a worthier person to come here an' aid us, $N. You've done a grand job!
BHe'll be pleased to see what an overwhelming success our mission's been.

720.name: A Sign of Hope
desc: Find Prospector Ryedol and let him know Hammertoe Grez is alive.
objectives: Find Prospector Ryedol and let him know Hammertoe Grez is alive.
details: <There is text roughly scribbled in chalk on the map.>
B"Ryedol, $BThey're taking me to Uldaman. Send help.$B-Hammertoe"
completion: Hammertoe's alive?! This is amazin', $N!

744.name: Preparation for Ceremony
desc: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.
details: $N, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.
BI want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?
BYou can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
completion: Thank you for your help, $N.
BMy part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.

768.name: Gathering Leather
desc: Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
details: Greetings, young one. You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt. May you bring honor to your clan!
BI work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.
BIf you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
completion: Ah, these are very nice pieces. They'll make fine leather goods.
BHere, $N. Take this in trade...

792.name: Vile Familiars
desc: Kill 12 Vile Familiars.
Return to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.
objectives: Kill 12 Vile Familiars.
BReturn to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.
details: I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young $c.
BI was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...

BA group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the Valley of Trials. They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their Vile Familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.
BAs your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
completion: You have done well, $N.
BAlthough the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.

816.name: Lost But Not Forgotten
desc: Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.
objectives: Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.
details: $N, please, can you help me? My son Kron went hunting days ago, and he still hasn't returned. He went west towards the Barrens to hunt crocolisks along Southfury River. I fear the worst.
BAs strong as he was, his stubborn pride has always drawn him into trouble. I warned him that the crocolisks were powerful and vicious. He grew angry and stormed off.
BIf you can't find him, at least bring me a sign of his fate... even if you have to open up the stomach of every crocolisk along the Southfury's banks.
completion: Oh, my son... my beautiful son.
BUncertain of my son's fate, I have tormented myself since he left. Now that I know what's happened, perhaps I can finally begin to mourn.
BThank you, $N. Please take this. I was going to give it to Kron as a gift when he returned successful. Now that I know he is dead, I cannot bear to look at it.

840.name: Conscript of the Horde
desc: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge.
Stop at the orc outpost across the bridge.
Give Kargal Battlescar at the Barrens outpost your recruitment letter.
objectives: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge.
BStop at the orc outpost across the bridge.
BGive Kargal Battlescar at the Barrens outpost your recruitment letter.
details: Hmm, you look pretty strong.
BListen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.
BTake this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
completion: Oh, so Takrin sent you? He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.
BI'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.

864.name: Return to Apothecary Zinge
desc: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
objectives: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
details: "Here you go, the power source is safely removed and the data is preserved. Well, safe journeys and all that. Hope the nefarious science experiment worked out for you and all."

BThe goblin turns away from you to attend to the demands of the Gadgetzan Water Company. You secure the sealed testing kit for the journey back to the Undercity. Apothecary Zinge waits for you and the sealed field testing kit there.
completion: I will analyze this data immediately. Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.
BAs for you... you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful. Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.
BCheck back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.

888.name: Stolen Booty
desc: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
objectives: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
details: While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

BAs you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!
BHead down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
completion: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, $N. You know, I could use a $R like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!

936.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
details: Excuse me $c, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

BThe Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.
BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
completion: Greetings, $C; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.

984.name: How Big a Threat?
desc: Find a corrupt furbolg camp in Darkshore and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
objectives: Find a corrupt furbolg camp in Darkshore and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
details: Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.

BI have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
completion: This is terrible news indeed, $N.
BWith the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.
BThank you, $N.

1008.name: The Zoram Strand
desc: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
objectives: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
details: There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.
BIt is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas. It has been lost to the night elves for ages. Lost, and nearly forgotten.
BNow, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know. But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!
BReturn to me when your mission is complete.
completion: Very well done, $N. Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.
BI know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves. We know this, for we share a history with them.
BIt is a history I care not to repeat.

1032.name: Satyr Slaying!
desc: Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in Forest Song.
objectives: Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in Forest Song.
details: I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... sad.
BI know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.
B
completion: Thank you, kind $R. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.

1056.name: Journey to Stonetalon Peak
desc: Travel to Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak.
objectives: Travel to Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak.
details: The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

BTo the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.
BThere awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, $r.
BThe journey will be perilous.
completion: Alas, you arrive. I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits...

1080.name: Covert Ops - Beta
desc: Retrieve the Venture Co. Letters from Windshear Mine at the east end of Windshear Crag.
objectives: Retrieve the Venture Co. Letters from Windshear Mine at the east end of Windshear Crag.
details: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, $N.
BWe cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.
BThe key is to get their letters... remember that.
BThe pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....
completion: Incredible, $N! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.

1104.name: Salt Flat Venom
desc: Bring 6 Salty Scorpid Venoms to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Bring 6 Salty Scorpid Venoms to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
details: I have so many designs for our rocket car! So many! And I must try them all!!
BI'm working on a new type of fuel. One that burns really really really hot!! I haven't gotten the mixture perfect, but I think I know what I need...
BThe scorpids who wander the Shimmering Flats have a venom with lots and lots of salt in it. It's very unique! And it's just what I need!
BBring me venom and trust me -- our car will fly!!
completion: All right! This venom is going to work great! Thanks, $N!
BNow I just need to boil it down, apply skipper-otomer, add a nega-catalyst, and... Drat! Where are my notes!?

1152.name: Test of Lore
desc: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
objectives: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
details: Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.
BIf you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $N.
BWhen you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $N, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
completion: The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.
BNow you stand before Braug.

1176.name: Load Lightening
desc: Get 10 Hollow Vulture Bones for Pozzik in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Get 10 Hollow Vulture Bones for Pozzik in the Shimmering Flats.
details: When it comes to racing, every bit counts! Whether it's a minor tweaking on the power output, a slight slackening on the tension coils, or lightening the weight of the frame, you have to take everything into account.

BWe use vulture bones for a lot of the minor structural tweaks we make to our racers, which offer the perfect balance of strength and weight. Even better, it's easy for us to get more, as the salt flats are littered with vultures.
BBring me some and I'll give you a good price on them.
completion: Great! I can get the crew working on this right away. Thanks, $n!

1200.name: Blackfathom Villainy
desc: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
objectives: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
details: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!
BLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.
BAku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.
BThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.
BSlay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, $N, please.
completion: Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.
BIt seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. For some time we considered him dead or missing.
BBut this makes perfect sense. By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.
BBy the light! To sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!
BYou have done a great deed, $N. I salute you on behalf of the Argent Dawn.

1248.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands.
objectives: Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands.
details: A contact of mine retired in the Wetlands at the harbor city of Menethil. He should be willing to help on your word alone if you tell him you're working for me. His name is Mikhail. He mentioned becoming a bartender before leaving Stormwind a few years ago.

BSpeak to him, find this Slim, and find out if there's anything else to know about this kidnapped diplomat. We need to find out where they've taken him, or at least who he is. The docket doesn't mention anything about their plans after he's captured.
completion: Welcome, welcome, welcome, $N. Good of you to join us. Perhaps an ale today? Or some mutton?
BName your pleasure and I'll see to it that you're taken care of. My name is Mikhail, and I look forward to serving you.
BHmm? What's that? Trias? Keep your voice down, my friend. This isn't something for the whole tavern to hear about.

1320.name: The Black Shield
desc: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
objectives: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
details: Ah, I almost missed this... The leather strap on the back must have burned off, but it seems like it was made to fit a large person. I'd guess a tauren, actually.
BThat's about all I can tell you. Tell Captain Vimes I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.
completion: That's not much information to work on, but we'll have to keep it in mind. Hopefully some of the other pieces of this mystery will fall into place, and paint a more helpful picture of what happened.

1368.name: Gelkis Alliance
desc: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
objectives: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
details: To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

BIf you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram. After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest Desolace.
completion: The earth speaks to me. And it says you have killed many Magram. This is good.
BIf you are a friend of the Gelkis, then listen. I have more tasks for you.

1392.name: Noboru the Cudgel
desc: Bring Noboru's Cudgel to the leader of The Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.
objectives: Bring Noboru's Cudgel to the leader of The Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.
details: Noboru has plagued the Draenei of the Harborage for months, and his cudgel is a symbol of the brutality they have suffered at the hands of the lost ones.
completion: You have gained the weapon of the dreaded Noboru? Is he then dead?

BThis is a joyous day for the Harborage. Noboru and his gang were a terror to us, wandering the swamps and killing any Draenei who crossed his path. He was a direct threat to our survival, and we did not have the strength to face him.
BWe are fortunate to have a friend in you, $N.

1440.name: Return to Vahlarriel
desc: Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
objectives: Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
details: So, the time is now then? I appreciate your efforts, and if the situation does not lend itself, then allow me to thank you now for everything you've done for me and my family. If you're ready, then there is nothing else for me here--we can leave when you feel the time is right.
completion: Thank you, $N. Dalinda made it safely back here to Nijel's Point, and in much better condition than I could have asked for. The fact that she arrived here under her own power was a good sign. I hope you're well?

BIt pains me to know that both Tyranis and Dalinda didn't return, but the embarrassment of Tyranis' decisions is hers to endure. It is something she will have to deal with when she returns to Darnassus.

1488.name: The Corrupter
desc: Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
objectives: Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
details: Although I have no knowledge of this Lord Azrethoc, I agree with Maurin, he must be stopped; especially if he is attempting to gain influence over the Burning Blade to further his goals.
BYou have already shown you wish to aid the Warchief, and I would trust you to gather a party to slay the demon lord and his warlock servant.
BWhen you are ready, head directly south, and return to me when the threat has been ended.
completion: A mighty victory for us all, $N. Let us rejoice in your success. I trust now that our future here is not as bleak as I once thought.
BThe demons will be slain, the Burning Blade will fail in their efforts, and we may one day have a place we can safely call home again.

1512.name: Love's Gift
desc: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
details: Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.
BLeave me, $n. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.
BAnd please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.
completion: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, $N. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.

1536.name: Call of Water
desc: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.
objectives: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.
details: Long ago I followed some companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the Forsaken had taken over: Tarren Mill.

BIt was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.
BBring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.
completion: This is good, $N. You're dedicated to the task at hand and have the ability to seek out that which is needed.
BOne more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Islen will be pleased as well.

1560.name: Tooga's Quest
desc: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
objectives: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
details: I am so lost!
BMy wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere.
BWould you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.
completion: So he couldn't find his way back on his own? Figures.
BWell, I guess you deserve something for your troubles....

1656.name: A Task Unfinished
desc: Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
details: $N, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.
BI'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?
BThe inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
completion: Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.
BThese came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

BPlease feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.

1680.name: Tormus Deepforge
desc: Speak with Tormus Deepforge.
objectives: Speak with Tormus Deepforge.
details: Now that you've learned some moves, it's time to get you a decent weapon. Speak with Tormus Deepforge. He can make you a weapon I'm sure you'll like.
BYou'll find Tormus here in Ironforge, at the Great Forge.
completion: Muren sent you, did he? Yes, I can make you a nice weapon... but before I do that, I have a favor to ask of you.
BDon't worry. It's plenty dangerous and could mean your death; it's exactly the sort of job a warrior wants.

1704.name: Klockmort Spannerspan
desc: Bring Furen's Notes to Klockmort Spannerspan.
objectives: Bring Furen's Notes to Klockmort Spannerspan.
details: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need someone to take them to Klockmort Spannerspan. He's a gnomish blacksmith in Ironforge and when he learns what I've learned... I bet he'll pull off his own beard in excitement.
completion: Oh my! These notes are amazing! And what's more... they're incredible and they're stupendous and they make my knees go all a-wobbly!
BFuren had a breakthrough! A real breakthrough! I can't wait to try out his new technique!

1800.name: Lordaeron Throne Room
desc: Take your ward to the old Lordaeron Throne Room that lies just before descending into the Undercity.
objectives: Take your ward to the old Lordaeron Throne Room that lies just before descending into the Undercity.$B
details: The orphan matrons at my home tell mighty stories of battle and lore at night if we are good and do our chores. One story was about how Lordaeron fell, and about how the evil Arthas took his own father's life to become ruler.
BHe had no honor, $N! When I grow up and become a mighty Horde warrior, my blade will be guided by honor - never evil!
BWould you take me to see the throne room, please? It is just before where you would go down into the Undercity.
completion: That throne room was scary, $N! Even though it was empty, it felt like a great evil had happened there. I felt mad... but I also felt sad too. I understand why the matrons tell us such stories; I will never betray my people like that!
BThank you for taking me to the throne room, $N. I learned a lot.

1824.name: Trial at the Field of Giants
desc: Bring 5 twitching antennae to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo
objectives: Bring 5 twitching antennae to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo
details: To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants. There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures. They are new to the Barrens and I do not like what they herald.
BBring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, $N, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long. Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.
completion: Nicely done, $N! In passing the trial at the Field of Giants, you take one more step down the warrior's path.

1848.name: Brutal Hauberk
completion: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, $N. Here is the product of your toil.
BMay you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.

1920.name: Investigate the Blue Recluse
desc: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment coffers from behind Jennea Cannon. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers to Jennea at the Wizard's Sanctum.
objectives: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment coffers from behind Jennea Cannon. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers to Jennea at the Wizard's Sanctum.
details: A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the Mage Quarter. Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

BI want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures. Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them. When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
completion: Very well done! I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.
BYour value to the society of mages grows, $N.

1944.name: Waters of Xavian
desc: Bring the Xavian Water Sample to Deino in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Xavian Water Sample to Deino in Orgrimmar.
details: The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned. It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.
BI would have a sample of those waters, from their source.

BTake this flask and go to Xavian. Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me. And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.
completion: Ah, very good. I trust the satyrs of Xavian gave you little trouble?
BThank you, $N. I will study this sample of Xavian water immediately.

2040.name: Underground Assault
desc: Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
objectives: Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
details: Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

BDeep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
completion: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!

2160.name: Supplies to Tannok
desc: Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
objectives: Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
details: Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?
BYou were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.
BAnyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
completion: Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.
BThanks for bring this to me, $N. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.

2280.name: The Platinum Discs
desc: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.
details: Touching the Discs of Norgannon once again makes your hand tingle. This time, however, a strange grinding noise is heard from inside the discs.
BYour backpack suddenly becomes heavier than it was before. Inside, you discover a miniature version of the discs!

BNo doubt, an item of this sort would be invaluable for someone interested in the ancient history of Azeroth. The sages of Thunder Bluff are such historians, known throughout the Horde; perhaps they can make good use of it.
completion: What are these here then?
BImpressive, young one! These discs, in them I sense secrets that the earth has held on to tightly for many years. You were very wise to bring them here to me.

2520.name: Sathrah's Sacrifice
desc: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
objectives: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
details: Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to Elune; lay the great spider to rest.
BInside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice. The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.
BWhen you have completed this, return to me.
completion: The loss of Lady Sathrah is distressing, but in this way only may she be reborn with a renewed spirit.
BMay Elune willingly accept the sacrifice that you have offered her.

2760.name: The Mithril Order
desc: Speak with Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Speak with Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.$B
details: Most of our recruits never make it to Booty Bay, $N. The shine of the insignia is enough to trigger the loot lust in even the staunchest of blacksmiths. Fools they be, as the insignia is a drop in the bucket compared to the wealth of items you'll see!
BFind Galvan the Ancient and show him this pin. His residence is far to the north, between Zul Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.$B
completion: Ah, many years it has been since one has been worthy of the mithril order's initiation. We will start now!

2784.name: Fall From Grace
desc: Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
objectives: Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
details: Hear my story, $r.
completion: As a spirit, I am powerless, $N. Assist me. Allow me to regain my honor.

2856.name: Wild Leather Vest
desc: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
objectives: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
details: Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set. The frame of the vest and the wildvine weave within it produces a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for potent magic to work its way through the garment.
BFor this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine. This is not an easy lesson, but it is one you certainly have the skill to complete.
completion: These are some very nice pieces here, $N. The craftsmanship and care put in to making these show you have chosen to dedicate yourself fully to these tasks.
BYou've met my requests, and with that comes your reward. The knowledge of making Wild Leather vests is now yours!

2880.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
desc: Bring 5 Troll Tribal Necklaces to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.
objectives: Bring 5 Troll Tribal Necklaces to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.
details: Get this straight, $r - we are NOT part of the Alliance! The Wildhammers are independent, relying on deeds and actions to prove one's worth, rather than the blather of those who use jibber-jabber to bolster their do-nothing attitudes!

BIf you're looking for friends here, then prove your worth to us first! The foul trolls that choke the hillsides of the Hinterlands sometimes carry tribal necklaces. Bring five of them to me, and we'll mark it down as a step in the right direction for you.
completion: Now that's what I am talking about! See - these necklaces prove that you're willing to get your hands dirty. We Wildhammers value that in those we associate with.
BYou keep this up, and you'll be in our good graces yet.

2904.name: A Fine Mess
desc: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
objectives: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
details: <Kernobee groans.> Wha.. What happened?
BThe last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.
BGet me out of here, $N!

BHere's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.
BLet's get going!
completion: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, $N. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

2928.name: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators
desc: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.
details: It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.
BWhat we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.
BWhat I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.$B
completion: This will do nicely, $N. One gyrodrillmatic excavationator fixed; 398 left to go.

2952.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
completion: As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt. A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward. Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow. The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status. Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box.
BWell, there is one way to find out if it cleaned the item or not...

2976.name: A Grim Discovery
desc: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
details: What?!
BAh, so I did mention a bounty, didn't I? Well, that'll teach me to open my mouth, won't it?

BYou did the work, so I suppose it is only right you reap the greatest reward from it. Take the horns, I'll have them put in a crate for you. Find Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor, he'll want to know what you saw and he'll reward you for your hard work.
BBe well, $c, and thank you again for everything you've done.
completion: The Grimtotem!? This is interesting. You say you came across them while hunting in Feralas? Truly?
BMy peers will want to hear your news, $C. Tell me more and I'll count out your coin while you do so.
BAnd before you go, know that I give you thanks for the information you've passed on to me this day.

3000.name: Tome of Divinity
desc: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
details: Hello, $N. I know you're busy helping out the people of Azeroth, but when you have the time, you should return to Ironforge and speak to one of the most respected paladins of your home: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger dwarven paladins go to when it is time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of all of us.
BYou can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries which is located in the Mystic Ward.
completion: I greet you, and bid you welcome, $N.

3096.name: Encrypted Scroll
desc: Read the Encrypted Scroll and speak to David Trias in Deathknell.
objectives: Read the Encrypted Scroll and speak to David Trias in Deathknell.
details: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the rogue trainer David Trias. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
completion: I spend most of my time here in the inn keeping an eye out for new faces and just keeping tabs on up-and-coming prospects. Keep your nose clean and I'll do what I can to teach you a few things. Just come back to me whenever you want, and we'll see if you're ready for a new skill or two.

3120.name: Verdant Sigil
desc: Read the Verdant Sigil and speak to Mardant Strongoak, in the tree Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
objectives: Read the Verdant Sigil and speak to Mardant Strongoak, in the tree Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
details: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our druid trainer, Mardant. It seems Mardant would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
completion: I will be your mentor and guide for now. It is my duty to teach you how to interpret not only what the spirits communicate to us, but also the complexities and secrets of the Emerald Dream.
BAs you learn and grow in power, you will learn more of our sleeping trance. But until then, return to me as often as you like and I will teach you what I can in the ways of our kind.

3504.name: Betrayed
desc: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
objectives: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
details: Betraying, thieving woman! That's what I call her--that's all she'll ever be!
BI may have made a grave mistake, $N. I trusted a blood elf. What's worse, I trusted a woman!
BShe claimed Azshara would hold great riches... powerful items. I simply send some warriors with her to protect her and I would be rewarded. Well, look who's the fool--she's killed them all.
BI want vengeance, $N, but I can't afford to send anyone else. Find Ag'tor at Valormok, north of the Haldarr Encampment. He'll tell you more.
completion: We've sent everything we had at her and her workers, but they are strong in battle. None have bothered to return. I'm assuming some have died, but I'm sure others simply ran... cowards.
BBut now that reinforcements have arrived, perhaps there's still something we can do. Perhaps we can still punish her for lying and betraying Belgrom.
BWhat do you say, are you in?

3528.name: The God Hakkar
desc: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
objectives: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
details: Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.
BTake the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth. Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.

BHe will send his minions against you. Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit. When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.
BDefeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
completion: The essence of Hakkar has been collected! Even now the Egg stirs with life! Could the myths of Hakkar be true?
BThat must not be true, for it is then I fear what Hakkar may do if birthed again. I will keep this egg safe and be sure it does not fall into evil hands.
BYour labors with me are finished, $N. You have touched a legend, and your actions may one day change the face of our world.

3912.name: Meet at the Grave
desc: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.
objectives: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.
details: This elixir will allow you to speak with one that you would not normally even see...
BTake the Videre elixir, along with Linken's sword, to the graveyard just outside Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Once there, drink the potion. You may be quite surprised at the results, but do not be alarmed.
BIn your "other" form, head due north until you reach the mountains. You'll find the one you need to speak with in one of the rocky crevices. His name is Gaeriyan.
BRemember, he will only speak to you in that form...
completion: It has been long since any have come to talk with me...

4128.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
desc: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.
objectives: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.
details: Ho, $n. I heard that Ragnar Thunderbrew is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale. He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.
BTalk to Ragnar if you're interested. He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh.
completion: You're right I'm mad! I've been robbed! Robbed of one of our family recipes! How dare they! As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves! Now, oh... now they're in for it!

4224.name: The True Masters
desc: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.
objectives: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
BYou recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.
details: What? You thought you were the first? How many soldiers must we lose before Stormwind acts?

BWe had accumulated enormous amounts of intelligence pertaining to the Blackrock menace before we lost our commanding officer, Marshal Windsor. With Marshal Windsor went all of our precious information.
BWhat we need is that documentation. Speak with Ragged John, $N. He was with Windsor when they were attacked by a Blackrock raiding party. He was last seen in a cave to the north.
completion: I could have warned you, but what fun is that?

4296.name: Tablet of the Seven
desc: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
details: I came to the Burning Steppes, following the legends of the Seven. They were dwarves of great knowledge and power, and if you have knowledge and power, then wealth is sure to follow.
BThat's what I want. Wealth!

BIf we can learn more of the Seven, then maybe we can get rich together. The ruins of Thaurissan is rumored to keep the Tablet of the Seven, which holds knowledge of the ancient dwarves. Find this tablet, copy its text and bring it to me. Let's discover its secrets together!
completion: Ah, you found the tablet! And your transcription is superb! Are you sure you're a $C and not a scribe?
BHere you are, $N. Here is the payment I promised.

4488.name: Summon Felsteed
desc: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
details: Ah, $N, you've seen fit to grace us with your presence. How wonderful!

BI hope you do not expect us to wait on you hand and foot also. You may be growing quickly in power, but you still are a pup when it comes to true knowledge and understanding. If you're not careful, corruption will overwhelm you and your weak will.
BBut I should get to the point: Strahad wishes to speak to you. He is still residing in his tower overlooking Ratchet in the Barrens. I suggest not taking too long.

4512.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
desc: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
details: But the thing I've studied most is ooze. I know it sounds odd, but they're all over!

BI helped a lady in Menethil find her bag not too long ago--it was eaten by oozes. I've seen members of the Royal Apothecary Society from Undercity collecting samples of the stuff. I want to know why! Where does it come from?
BI've heard of more in Felwood. What I need are samples of the oozes there so I can further my research. I'll give you containers, you use them to collect a sample from the deceased creatures.
completion: Amazing results, $N! You got close enough to take a sample of the corrupted things, and managed to look no worse for wear! Thank you. Oh, these samples will be perfect. I can't wait to start testing on them.
BIf I'm right, I could be one of the Explorers' Leagues greatest scientists!
BThat'll prove to all the dwarves that it wasn't a mistake to allow us gnomes into Ironforge after the Gnomeregan incident.

4728.name: Beached Sea Creature
desc: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
objectives: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
details: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of giant sea mammal lies partially gutted on the beach. A wheelbarrow and various tools lie abandoned by this enormous beached sea creature, as though an attempt to study it had been made previously. Though murlocs have scavenged this beast, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
completion: Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League. They have a presence here in Darkshore, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs. You appear to have succeeded where we both have not. Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.

4968.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
desc: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: Hmm, you've made it this far... truly astonishing. I would have thought the corruption of channeling the arcane would have seeped into your very soul and driven you mad by now. How about we try and push you further then?
BIf you want to test your skill, seek out Menara Voidrender above Ratchet in Strahad's tower. She will guide you.
completion: Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. That I can help you if you truly are prepared.
BIt's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.
BSo, do you feel you're ready, $N?

5064.name: Grimtotem Spying
desc: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
objectives: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
details: $N, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.
B$N, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.$B
completion: Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.
B$N, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
B

5088.name: Arikara
desc: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.
objectives: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.
details: Take this refined and purified Incendia powder to Thousand Needles and toss it on the sacred fire of life. It is located in the Darkcloud Pinnacle on an isolated needle where they bury their dead.
BThe enchantment that I have weaved into the Incendia powder will summon Arikara to you, $N.
BI fear she may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof; too much Tauren lore has changed, and I fear this has angered Arikara. Move quickly before all is lost, $c!
completion: This does not make sense. Why would Arikara be after Cairne Bloodhoof? Magatha could not be wrong, she is our most powerful shaman.
B<Motega shakes his head.>
BRegardless, your great deed to the Horde shall not go unnoticed - please, choose one of these as a reward for your aid.

5160.name: The Matron Protectorate
desc: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
objectives: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
details: Travel to Kalimdor, $r. Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of Winterspring. Once you reach Winterspring, find the caves of Mazthoril.
BUpon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to Haleh, our matron protectorate.
BGive her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.
completion: The Aspects insist that we stay out of the affairs of mortals. In this world, however, such a thing is not always possible - especially when one of our own contemptuously disregards such edicts.

5232.name: Return to the Bulwark
desc: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: You carefully fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's ichors for what you consider to be suitably sized sample.
BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
completion: Ah, there is plenty in here for study. Well done, $N!
BFor now, the next step is in our hands. We'll need to produce a list of reagents that, when combined with what is already in the cauldron, will act as its counter.

BThe only way we will be able to introduce this is by placing the reagents into the cauldron directly. Apothecary Dithers will have more information on that, so be sure to speak with him as soon as possible.

5544.name: Carrion Grubbage
desc: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
objectives: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.$B
details: My food supplies are running low, $r. I am ashamed to admit that I might not have enough food to share with you.

BCould you assist an old man with a simple task? Around here, the only manner of beast unaffected by the ravages of the Plague are the Carrion worms. While rather bland in taste, the meat of the worms can easily be preserved to last for months. I will need several hundred pounds to restock for the coming winter!
completion: May the Light watch over you! Bless you, young one.

5904.name: A Plague Upon Thee
desc: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
objectives: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
details: Now that we have the termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.

BOnce there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; find someplace suitable, like on a crate and then open it. The termites should do their work from there and make the mill useless to the Crusade.
completion: The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.

5928.name: Heeding the Call
desc: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
details: Excuse me, friend...

BIt has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.
BHe is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
completion: I am glad you found your way here today. young $C. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

BInside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.
BReady yourself!

6024.name: Hameya's Plea
desc: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
objectives: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
details: Kill me. Before it's too late.
BI am Hameya. While traveling to Zul'Mashar, my brethren and I ate some bad meat... and we changed. We are infected.
BI can feel the lich's words now, urging me to reach Zul'Mashar and infect more of my people. I cannot resist, and so I wrote this scroll before my will left me.
BI buried a chest in dirt next to a wagon behind this crypt, but only my key will open it. I have the key. If you want my treasure, then find me.
BKill me. Before it's too late.
completion: Hameya's chest is opened!!

6072.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
objectives: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, it is time, $c.

6144.name: The Call to Command
desc: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.
objectives: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.
details: The order has come down, $c. Varimathras himself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.
BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.
