B<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>
BTravel to the Undercity at once and report to Varimathras. Do not embarrass me, $c!
completion: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the Scarlet Bastion while his forces pour into your lands, desecrate your structures and monuments and murder your people.
BThe Dark Lady has commanded that I deal with this insect once and for all. You will become the instrument of the Forsaken's reckoning.

6384.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
desc: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
details: For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar. When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka. Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.
BSpeak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
completion: Oh, wonderful! Those are fine cuts! These are from Zargh, are they? That orc sure knows his way into a lady's heart...
BOh, I can't wait to cook it. But not too much! Meat is best served rare, don't you think?

6504.name: The Lost Pages
desc: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.
objectives: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.$B
details: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.
BThe pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
completion: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, $N!

6624.name: Triage
desc: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.
objectives: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

BRemember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.
details: Good day, doctor. You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Alliance Trauma.

BNow pay attention! The critically injured must be tended to first. After the criticals come the badly injured. The injured should be tended to last. You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.
BGood luck, doctor.$B
completion: Doctor $N, welcome to Alliance Trauma.

6984.name: A Smokywood Pastures Thank You!
desc: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
details: We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, $N. For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!

BPlease, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!
completion: Ho ho hello, adventurer!

BThe goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.

7224.name: Enemy Booty
desc: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.
objectives: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.
details: When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me. I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!
completion: These will do nicely. I'll melt them down and patch them up and you'll never know they came from those Stormpike cowards!
BThanks, $N. And let me polish up that armor of yours...

7368.name: Defusing the Threat
desc: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Frostwolf Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
objectives: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Frostwolf Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
details: I know all about landmines. I'm the one that lays all the mines on the front lines here, after all.

BIf you want to defuse the Stormpike mine fields, all you have to do is kill their explosives expert. That dwarven coward is no doubt hiding in the first tower on the Field of Strife. Take him out and those landmines won't come back after they've been disarmed.
BIf you do happen to kill him, come back here and let me know. No good deed should go unrewarded.
completion: NULL

7488.name: Lethtendris's Web
desc: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
objectives: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
details: The mage Lethtendris, a vicious blood elf whose brutality is matched only by her twisted addiction to magic, has fled into Dire Maul. She has created a device, a web to ensnare the magical energies of that place and we fear that, if left unchecked, she will cause irreparable damage to our world!
BStop her, $N. Find her and retrieve her web. She is likely near the satyrs in Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul. Bring the web to me so that its power may be released safely back into the wilds...
completion: You retrieved the web! Well done, $N! Lethtendris, like many elves of her ilk, are blind to the dangers the abuse of magic can cause to our world. They believe they are masters of magic; they do not realize that they are slaves to their own addiction. Her death saddens me, but it was necessary.
BThank you, $N. I will have the energies within the web released safely over a wide area, and then I'll destroy it to prevent future magical exploits.

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
desc: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, $N; It's a big world.
objectives: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, $N; It's a big world.
details: The epidermis of the leaf glows a bright green. The surface is extremely rugose, exposing several veins and wrinkles.
BIf you had to take a guess, you would say this leaf came from something ancient and powerful.
BMaybe you should find the original owner of this leaf?
completion: Of course I recognize my own leaves. Look at that! It's in perfect condition.
BHow good of you to return it, $C.
BPerhaps you could be of service to us and we to you.

7656.name: Imperial Plate Chest
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya.
BAnd $N, wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

7704.name: Look at the Size of It!
desc: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.
objectives: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.
details: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Chambermaid had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.
completion: This is better than even I could have thought possible! The Chambermaid's magical pillow is mine! You better believe you're going to get a nice reward for this accomplishment, $N!

7728.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
desc: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.
objectives: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

BThe only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.
details: The following items have been stolen:
B*One Dark Iron Tuyere.
B*One Lookout's Spyglass.
BA reward is being offered to individuals who find and return these pilfered items.
BThe Thorium Brotherhood is certain that these items were stolen by unscrupulous and jealous Dark Iron dwarves that inhabit the Searing Gorge.
BThe spyglass in question was an excellent tool for the lookouts and the tuyere was an irreplaceable smithing tool.
BShould you find the missing items, return them to Scrange.
completion: Fantastic work! Now for your reward.

7800.name: A Donation of Runecloth
completion: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

7824.name: A Donation of Runecloth
completion: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

7848.name: Attunement to the Core
desc: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
objectives: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
details: Rifts stir, tear, and collapse all around us, $r. Not two paces from where I stand is a tear leading through the depths of Blackrock Mountain, into the maw of the Firelord.
BSurprised? Pity... The mortal races cannot comprehend that which they cannot see, touch, or feel.
BI assure you, the portal is there and access is possible.
BI've piqued your interest? Attunement is simple. Venture into Blackrock Depths and retrieve a core fragment. Return it to me and I shall attune your essence with the portal.
completion: I am now able to transport you to the Molten Core. Ask and it shall be done.

7872.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
details: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young $c. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.
BEnter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!
BDo this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, $N, and I shall reward you.
completion: NULL

8064.name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Belt
desc: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Sash. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Honored with Zandalar.
objectives: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Sash. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Honored with Zandalar.
details: We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around. Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so. To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them. That is the real power of nature.
BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us. Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.
BStrong mojo, ya mon!
completion: I thank you - the latent power in these items will be treasures unto themselves, you betcha. Not only have ya done as I've asked of ya, but you've also proven to be honorable to us here in the tribe. As promised, here is your reward!

8112.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
completion: Now you take the evil trolls in Zul'Gurub and show them what your nature powers can do, mon!

8160.name: Cut Arathor Supply Lines
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
details: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

BYou can help us, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
completion: NULL

8232.name: The Green Drake
desc: Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
objectives: Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
details: Now I set you on a dangerous hunt to slay the green drake, Morphaz, and bring his tooth to me. Morphaz dwells deep in Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in Swamp of Sorrows.
BIf you wish to defeat him, you must not go alone. This drake is an enemy of many -- seek others who wish to destroy him.
BThe drake's tooth represents the power a hunter will find in the company of others. Bring it to me and you will have learned much.
completion: You have learned the old ways, $N, and for that I offer you a gift from my days as a hunter.

8256.name: The Ichor of Undeath
desc: Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
objectives: Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
details: For this restorative salve, you must use a simple formula: one part poison, two parts cure. You have acquired one cure, now you must gather the poison.

BPowerful undead, such as the lingering highborne who wander the Ruins of Eldarath, are sometimes so infused with evil that it coalesces into a sickly greenish goo. To the living, this substance is known as ichor of undeath.
BDue to the potency of this vile element, I require only a single ichor.
completion: I cannot say I'm pleased to receive such a wretched substance, but it is a necessary evil. Thank you, $N.

8280.name: Securing the Supply Lines
desc: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
objectives: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
details: Cenarion Hold is a location of utmost strategic importance. I'm convinced that while we hold it our victory over the silithid is guaranteed. Provided our influx supplies can be maintained, that is.

BDesert worms have proven to be more of a threat to our supply caravans than even the silithid themselves. Just this morning, a large shipment of morrowgrain was ravaged by a group of dredge strikers. I need you to thin their numbers to ensure our supplies aren't jeopardized.
completion: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.

8304.name: Dearest Natalia
desc: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold.
Once you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.
objectives: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold.
BOnce you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.
details: My dear Natalia has gone missing.

BTruth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research.
BShe was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south.
BMy soldiers are spread too thin, $N. I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves.
completion: <Commander Mar'alith lowers his head in contemplation.>
BWhether she is alive or dead, I must do what is right. She must be found. Alas, I am bound by duty to this outpost. Will you help me once more, $N?

8352.name: Scepter of the Council
desc: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
details: Huum and I were just talking about you. He tells me you're just about ready to try your hand at fighting an Abyssal Lord!

BI must tell you this is a very dangerous endeavor. You'd better bring backup. And I don't mean one or two of your friends, I'm talking about a top-notch, battle-ready fighting force. If your friends are as good as you, you might even defeat it!
BIf you do - and I'll want evidence, as always - I'll give you a truly great reward.
completion: You... you did it! You did it, $N! Here! Take this. It's the biggest chest we had lying around and I filled it with some of the best stuff we found.

8376.name: Armaments of War
completion: War comes, $N, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
B<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>
BThe future of us all could be at an end.
BThese armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.

8400.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.
BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.
BDo your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, $N! For the Alliance!
completion: Good work, $N. Thanks to you, our natural defenses in Ashenvale will remain intact for another day.

8424.name: War on the Shadowsworn
desc: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
objectives: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
details: The continued presence of the shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands bring great pain to me. Their dark rituals and spells cause agony unlike any I felt while alive.
BThrough you I can deliver my own message of pain. Go forth and deliver my wrath.
completion: Already you have subdued my pain and honored me. Thank you, warrior.

8520.name: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough silk bandages.
BDo you think you can help me out, $c?
completion: This Nightscape equipment you have supplied fills the order perfectly, $N. I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.
BYou have definitely earned this pattern. I give it to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.

8616.name: The Horde Needs More Baked Salmon!

8688.name: Windrun the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8712.name: Scythe of the Unseen Path
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
completion: You've done well, $C. This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.
BTake your weapon, $N. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

8736.name: The Nightmare Manifests
desc: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.
objectives: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.$B
details: We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.
BTyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.
BBe on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.$B
completion: He is redeemed, $n. He now returns to the Dream to right what he alone has done wrong. Eranikus will be a powerful ally to Malfurion and my father.
BThese armaments are for you, $n; given to me by Ysera herself. You would do well to make use of them in your battles against the Qiraji.

8760.name: The Path of the Invoker

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the invoker!

8904.name: Dangerous Love
desc: Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the Undercity.
objectives: Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the Undercity.
details: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's disgusting, and as it lowers our defenses, it could be a threat to the all of us.
BIt's bad enough that so many of our people are caught up in this ridiculous behavior. But I think that it has spread even to our guardians, who should be immune to such things.
BFind one of our guardians and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
completion: So it is true. This is unbelievable. How could this have happened? Let me think for a moment. There must be a reason behind this.

8928.name: A Shifty Merchant
desc: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
details: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.
BI met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods. He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly. I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.
BHe lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge. Sneak in there and try to find him.
BMake sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
completion: You did it! This rod will do perfectly. Now to put it all together...

8952.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

9000.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Deliana your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
objectives: Give Deliana your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
details: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
BI hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

9024.name: Aristan's Hunch
desc: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Morgan Pestle in the Trade District of Stormwind.
objectives: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Morgan Pestle in the Trade District of Stormwind.
details: I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.
BThat is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.
BThere is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
completion: I understand Aristan's concerns, but I really think he's overreacting. Let young men and women do what they will. I think Aristan has forgotten what it means to be young and in love.
BBut it would be better not to tell him that. We'll humor him.

9120.name: The Fall of Kel'Thuzad
desc: Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.
BSomeone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
completion: NULL

9240.name: Glacial Vest
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 8 Bolts of Runecloth, 6 Essences of Water, 4 Ironweb Spider Silks and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 8 Bolts of Runecloth, 6 Essences of Water, 4 Ironweb Spider Silks and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create a Glacial vest. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9264.name: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff
desc: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
details: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Thunder Bluff from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

objectives: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
*Dry Branch (6)
*Collecting Basket (quest item) (provided)
details: My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."
If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

objectives: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
*Murloc Eye#Classic (3)
details: I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.
If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.

objectives: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
details: One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.

objectives: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
* Windstone Cluster (15)
details: Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on zephras with us vanished several centuries ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.
You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove, think you can help me harvest them?

objectives: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
*Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans
details: These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.
You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.

objectives: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
* Titan Relic (Forever) (provided)
details: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.

objectives: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
details: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.

objectives: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
* Arcane Mote
* Dalaran Sewer Key (provided)
details: You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.
Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.

objectives: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
details: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.
I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.

objectives: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
* Escore Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost
details: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!
I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
